answer.evidence: Transmitter end-of-life: bias rose steadily from 45.34mA avg (Oct13) to 70.14mA avg (Oct23) then clamped at ~71.4mA (71.43 avg Oct26, 72.16 max hourly), APC can no longer maintain power. TX power then fell continuously from +0.4dBm baseline to -3.98dBm hourly (Oct27 07:00) and -3.12dBm daily avg Oct26. RX power fell by same amount (-10.91dBm baseline to -15.32dBm min Oct26/-15.26 hourly) keeping link loss ~11.3dB vs commissioning 10.93dB@1550, proving fibre plant unchanged. Embedded OTDR A/B at 1625nm shows only expected G.652/G.655 mismatch gainer at SC-06 and normal fibre attenuation 0.209dB/km, no new bend/splice/break loss. RX_LOW_WARNING correlates to TX fall, not fibre, and BER rise is secondary to low RX power.
